title: Preparation of Fe–N co-doped carbon-based catalysts and their influence on tetracycline degradation properties

A high-performance Fe–N co-doped carbon-based catalyst was prepared to activate PMS degrading tetracycline by a one-step pyrolysis using ferbam, melamine and sucrose.
